title: Callers Me Response
description: Response returned by GET /callers/me (packages/api/src/routes/callers-me.ts). Resolved, not raw: allowedPrincipalIds/allowedCapabilities reflect the effective scope after defaults are applied (isPrincipalAllowed.ts / isCapabilityAllowed.ts), not the raw ApiKeyEntry configuration. Never returns key material.

allowedPrincipalIds.description: Principal IDs this caller may assert as authority.principalId. Defaults to [callerId] when the key's allowedPrincipalIds is unset.

allowedCapabilities.description: Capabilities (intent.action values) this caller may execute. Defaults to an empty array, not all capabilities, when the key's allowedCapabilities is unset.

unrestrictedCapabilities.description: True when allowedCapabilities contains the wildcard "*".
